test.//inputs: Exclude *.e2e.ts so editing a resource-consuming suite never invalidates the default lane's cache — it never runs those files (its vitest `include` is `src/**/*.spec.ts`, see vite.config.ts). Mirrors the workspace targetDefaults.test inputs plus the negative pattern.

e2e.//: RESOURCE-CONSUMING lane. Runs ONLY the `*.e2e.ts` suites extracted out of the default `test` target (real live-dispatched Express servers bound to real ports, driven over real HTTP round-trips). REACHABILITY (2026-09-28, backlog-e2e-cache-separation): it is NOT in any `test.dependsOn` (the default lane stays fast), but it IS reached by the push/CI gate's `nx affected -t e2e` — the gate's target list is canonicalised in `tools/gate/lane-gate.mjs` (`GATE_TARGETS = ['test','e2e']`), which `.githooks/pre-push` and both CI workflows consume — and by `publish` via the conditional in `tools/nx-plugins/build/plugin.js` (`hasE2e ? ["e2e"] : []`). It is cached (`cache:true` + `inputs`) so a repeat gate run is a cache HIT, never an uncached re-run. `dependsOn: ["build"]` because it builds the package before exercising its real run() path. Its coverage dir is DISTINCT from the default lane's, and declares no dist-shaped output.
